notes.title: Raids Update is live!
notes.content: [p]Hi adventurers,[/p][p][/p][p]I'm back from my summer break with a new update! And I've been adding quite some new mechanics for this "[b]Raids Update[/b]"![/p][p]First of all I'm really glad that fortress walls are not just for decoration and prestige anymore, now they'll protect you from [b]real threats[/b]. And I really hope that you'll enjoy building [b]traps[/b] and [b]defense weapons[/b].[/p][p]I'm curious about your feedback on the raid system, as it probably needs some tuning and [b]balancing[/b], so don't hesitate to share your thoughts about it.[/p][p]And apart from that, I also worked on some of the [b]most requested features from the community[/b]: improvements to the [b]hero selection screen[/b] and the [b]recruiting board[/b]. So now you can regenerate only the hero look or stats, and you can also save your favorite heroes and reuse them in other games. And for recruits, you can finally dismiss them, and you can also regenerate their look to make sure they'll fit with your colony dress code![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43077298/bd35b188cde081e0a0074e30ee0e9bc6f83b6466.png"][/img][/p][p]Here's the complete changelog:[/p][list][*][p]Added the ability to create safe areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a button to switch to an emergency state causing all heroes to retreat into safe areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Added health points to buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability for enemies to attack buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a repair job for heroes to repair damaged buildings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a raid system sending enemies to attack the colony.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a gameplay setting to control the raids frequency.[/p][/*][*][p]Added health points to enemies in colony mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Now when losing a fight, enemies will also lose health points and when coming back to attack the same group, it will be less populated.[/p][/*][*][p]Added constructible defense weapons (with traps and projectiles).[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to display a layer with all positions covered by defense weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a rearm job to refill defense weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added walls with arrowslits to allow ballistas to shoot through.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a workshop to build defense weapons ammunitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added warning messages when a raid is detected or buildings are attacked.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a mood malus when heroes flee from combat.[/p][/*][*][p]On the heroes selection menu, added the ability to only regenerate the look or the stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to save a hero to a file and reload it.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the recruiting board menu, now recruits can be dismissed, and heroes look can be regenerated.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the schedule and jobs menu to keep the header always visible, and added the heroes class and level as a tooltip of their portrait.[/p][/*][*][p]Added texts mentioning that heroes won't sow plants during winter, and that tomato stalks can be destroyed during winter.[/p][/*][*][p]Various fixes to the job attribution system.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed UI issues with widescreens, and added back the ability to scale down the UI.[/p][/*][/list][p]As usual, I'll spend the coming weeks fixing issues and balancing the game depending on your feedback, and then I'll move to the next update. My current plan is to work on a trading system, and I can't wait to start on it![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Serge from LS Games[/p]

notes.title: New UI & Graphics Update is live!
notes.content: [p]Hi adventurers,[/p][p][/p][p]I'm really glad to release this [b]New UI & Graphics Update[/b]! My goal was to address some of the [b]major complaints about the game[/b], so I decided to work with people way more competent than me in those areas.[/p][p]First I asked Jérémy, the artist I worked with for the key art of the game, he made me a [b]complete new proposal for the game's UI[/b], taking into account my constraints while improving all aspects of it.[/p][p]And then he introduced me to Gauthier, a 3D artist. He was able to customize the models I've been using to make something [b]more detailed and more aligned with the vision I always had for the game[/b], while still providing a lot of customization options.[/p][p]Of course everything is not yet perfect, but it should be [b]a way better base to build upon[/b]. And It was really great and motivating to work with other people on the game, I really hope to be able to continue doing it for future updates![/p][p]And in parallel, with this update I also tried to [b]fix some long standing issues in the game[/b] (roads should not clip anymore!), to try to have it in the best shape possible before working back on new systems and content. It's quite a [b]big milestone[/b] for me and I really hope you'll like this version as much as I do.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43077298/450b279f91e8db0c500130a76cee2990c202ed5b.png"][/img][/p][p]Here's the complete changelog:[/p][list][*][p]Updated the heroes 3D models[/p][/*][*][p]Updated all the game UI[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the UI scale option[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed compatibility issues with old saves[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Crypt skeletons models[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking on the prestige flag now centers the view on the colony center[/p][/*][*][p]Added activity indicators to heroes on the portrait list[/p][/*][*][p]Added visible weapons to the Alchemist (only on new recruits)[/p][/*][*][p]Counter attack is now also applied on a miss[/p][/*][*][p]Overwatch and traps are now activated when pushing an enemy into it[/p][/*][*][p]Various balancing on trap and overwatch abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Added a custom cursor to the game[/p][/*][*][p]Clicking on a resource in the resource bar now centers the camera on this resource. Setting a priority on this resource type is now done with a righ-click[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies now also have chances to miss their target and hit an obstacle or another enemy[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon rune abilities are now free to use[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced wolf critical strike chances[/p][/*][*][p]Improved pathfinding to avoid infinite cycles between two agents when they need to recalculate a path after colliding[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced flowers resources and improved materials for them[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue allowing to attack through two walls touching corners[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue allowing counter attack to be activated even if the opponent is pushed away[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with combat LoS warnings not properly displayed on some resolutions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues when multiple overwatch are triggered at the same turn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with roads randomly disappearing on some camera angles after being built[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with some shadows flickering occasionally[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]And now it's time for me to take some vacations! I'll still be around in the coming days to fix some issues if needed, but then I'll be back in September to start working on a new update.[/p][p]Of course, thanks again to everyone for your great support, and please don't forget to leave a review for the game, it helps a lot with its discoverability![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Serge from LS Games[/p]

notes.title: Weapons & Armors Update is live!
notes.content: [p]Hi adventurers,[/p][p][/p][p]The [b]Weapons & Armors[/b] [b]Update[/b] is now live for everyone (game and demo). I've been working hard to provide a unique system for you to craft [b]customized weapons and armors[/b] depending on your needs or style, I really hope you'll enjoy it![/p][p]I've added a [b]new loot system[/b] for you to retrieve runes, and those runes can then be used to craft new weapons and armors you can [b]equip to your heroes[/b]. And with it, I've added [b]new combat mechanics[/b] like critical strikes or DOT resistances (skeletons can't bleed anymore...), and I've rebalanced the whole progression system to take into account heroes equipment to reflect their power.[/p][p]  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43077298/f2c6ea11e5647ecba913b3c30b36cab59a6ed66b.png"][/img][/p][p]Here's the complete changelog:  [/p][list][*][p]Added new workshops to build weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Added 2 new jobs: Weapon Crafting and Armor Crafting[/p][/*][*][p]Added a system to create custom recipes for weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to equip and show equipped weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new loot system with runes allowing to craft weapons[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new game option allowing to modify the rune loot rate[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for critical strikes during combats[/p][/*][*][p]Added weapon runes based combat abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Added 2 slots to dungeon inventories[/p][/*][*][p]Added workshops to build armors[/p][/*][*][p]Added equipable light and heavy armors[/p][/*][*][p]Added combat resistances to critical strikes, poison, bleed and fire[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to replace an armor or weapon without removing the old one first[/p][/*][*][p]Added information to combat portrait tooltips[/p][/*][*][p]Added poison, bleed and fire defence stats to enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability for enemies to make critical strikes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a potential crash when saving while eating[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with heal potions abilities not restoring the correct amount of HP[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various issues with combat actions not properly performed[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This update should work without problems with existing saves, but be aware that without any equipment, you'll take more damage and be less powerful than before, so you'll need to gear up to be able to deal with the same challenges as before.[/p][p][/p][p]Don't hesitate to provide me feedback about this new version of the game, I'll try to fix it as soon as possible in case of issues, and in parallel I've started working on the next update, and you'll probably like it, but I won't say anything more yet![/p][p]And of course, thanks everyone for your support, and please don't forget to leave a review for the game, it helps a lot for its discoverability![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Serge from LS Games[/p]

Hi adventurers,

The [b]Potions Update[/b] is now live for everyone (game and demo). You'll experience a [b]new system to grow plants[/b], and with new plants (you can finally plant your own trees). I've also [b]improved the stock areas management[/b], now you can customize what you want to store in each area.

Thanks everyone for your support, and please don't forget to leave a review for the game, it helps a lot for its discoverability!

Cheers,
Serge from LS Games

notes.title: Thanks for your feedback!
notes.content:
Hi adventurers,

I wanted to thank you for all your feedback! As you may know, in-game you can open a feedback menu and send me a note. When you're using this feature from the game, I actually receive your message, a save from the game made just before sending the data, and your log file.

It allows me to quickly check and reproduce a problem if it's what you're reporting, and it feeds me with a lot of interesting saves for me to use for testing new features or improvements, and validates that my modifications don't break your games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43077298/4ab67c8522f56dd49065c5b1149ab5f68a420ab8.png[/img]

Here's how it looks on my side, it populates a Trello board. The "Backlog" part is cards I received and haven't checked yet, or the ones I keep until I work on the issue it reports. And then I move the card on the "Archive" part.

So far I received approximately 400 feedback this way since opening the playtest of the game! And all my day's work on the game starts by checking the new cards.

So, what are you mostly asking for? So far, you mostly agree on two things:
[list]
[*] You want to be able to move furniture, and I totally agree that it's needed. It has been on my todo for a long time, but I definitely moved it to a higher priority following all the feedback I received for it. In the same category, you're also asking to be able to upgrade buildings instead of destroying and rebuilding. It's actually not something I was planning, but I added it to my todo and I'll see how it could be done.
[*] You want a better resource and stack management, with the ability to customize stock piles, and more generally have less stacks to manage. There's definitely a lot of room for improvement here and it's part of my todo. You're also asking for vaults or chests to actually store resources more easily. I was not planning it at all and I'm still not sure how it could be implemented, but don't hesitate if you have specific ideas in this area, I'm really interested in what you think about this topic.
[/list]
Apart from that, you're mostly asking for consumables and equipment, and well it's what I'm planning for the first major update of the game and I'm currently working on it, so stay tuned for this topic!

Thanks again for all the great feedback you sent me, and please continue, it helps me so much!

Cheers,
Serge from LS Games

notes.title: First week update!
notes.content:
Hi adventurers,

[b]The game is out for a week now[/b], and I wanted to thank everyone who played! It feels amazing to have new people discovering the game for the first time and giving me great feedback!

The first thing I can say, and it's very reassuring, it's that [b]the foundations seem quite solid[/b]. Most of you enjoy the formula, and technically it seems to work without major issues for most people too. It means that I won't spend the coming weeks chasing bugs or rewriting major parts of the game, and I'll be able to quickly move forward and work on the roadmap to improve the game and not just fix it.

My other observation from the early access launch is unfortunately less encouraging. [b]Sales are below my expectations[/b], it doesn't mean that I'll stop working on the game, but it means that my plans to work with other people to improve some aspects of it won't be possible for now.

But rest assured that I'll anyway do my best to bring the game to the best 1.0 possible! And if you want to help me, [b]please leave a review[/b], it's still the best way to help discoverability and allow to steadily grow the audience for the game.

And one final note, don't hesitate to [b]share your colonies![/b] I can't wait to see what you've built, and thanks to Jahon for his great contribution:

notes.title: New demo available!
notes.content:
Hi adventurers,

The early access release of the game is approaching, and you can get a first glimpse of it with the new demo! I've been working hard during those last few months to improve the overall quality of the game, and add new mechanics and content. I hope you'll enjoy it, here's an overview of the major modifications:

[list]
[*] Added procedural maps generation and added a large map option.
[*] Added seasons influencing the environment.
[*] Added a temperature system, and added the ability to visualize layers like lights and temperatures.
[*] Added traps to catch rabbits and improved the cooking system.
[*] Added the ability to start a game with a fog of war enabled.
[*] Added difficulties presets and lots of game customization options.
[*] Added a trait system for units.
[*] Added a new class, new combat abilities for all classes and new combat related constructions.
[*] Added new enemies.
[*] Improved the UI/UX with for instance a notification system in case of problems, or keyboard shortcuts for all actions.
[/list]

Your save from the demo will be compatible with the complete game, so feel free to start a new game on the demo and continue it when it will be released!

And of course I'll need your feedback to improve it as much as possible, so don't hesitate to join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/ZzkqDPWzCf]Discord[/url], or post on the Steam forums. And don't forget to leave a review on the demo page, it helps a lot!

Here's the full changelog:

[list]
[*] Added custom map generation from a seed
[*] Added a new large map size
[*] Added the ability to randomize enemies position when starting a game
[*] Added the ability to randomize dungeons position when starting a game
[*] Added the ability to enable enemies free roaming when starting a game
[*] Fortress spike gates does not require iron anymore to build
[*] Added full year support with four seasons
[*] Added support for terrain and vegetation to be visually updated depending on the season
[*] Added support for different day duration depending on the current season
[*] Added an UI indicator for the year evolution
[*] Added support for food growing depending on the current season
[*] Fixed an issue with terrain blinking on some maps
[*] Fixed roots effects not visually applied to the mutant enemy
[*] Improved support for forbidden zones created by enemies, it's not anymore dependant on the units distance, and it takes into account occluders
[*] Now units should stop working if an enemy is to close
[*] Fixed an issue if a construction job is inside a forbidden area, it doesn't block anymore other construction jobs to be done
[*] Added a visual feedback when a job is impossible to perform because it's too close of enemies
[*] Added a visual feedback for hauling jobs
[*] Fixed an issue corrupting tiles properties and allowing enemies and animals to walk through constructions
[*] Added light propagation display option

[*] Added a temperature system, with temperatures varying depending on seasons, or depending if inside a closed room or not
[*] Added a heat propagation system, with fire sources updated to create heat around them

[*] Added Vegetarian and Carnivorous traits

notes.title: Edge Islands first demo is live for Turn-Based RPG Fest!
notes.content:
Hi adventurers, 

I'm launching today the first demo of the game as part of the Turn-Based RPG Fest starting September 30th. This demo will allow you to experience one fully featured map, and to try most of the features which will be in the Early Access release. 

Demo features: 
[list]
[*] Build your colony up to its Prestige level 4
[*] Recruit and train up to 7 heroes
[*] Participate in turn-based combats to gain XP and level up
[*] Develop and customize your heroes up to their level 4
[*] Explore dungeons to bring back loot and expand your colony
[/list]
Join the Discord or use the Steam forums to share your feedback, and please don't hesitate to write a review on the demo page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3006310/Edge_Islands_Demo

This project started 4 years ago as a side project for me, I'm working alone on it and it's a big accomplishment for me to finally share a demo with you all!

I hope you will have fun with it and please, don't forget to wishlist the game, it helps a lot!

Cheers,
Serge from LS Games
